description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the ThingCreated event class, verifying immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and event parsing behavior.

classes.name: ThingCreatedTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the ThingCreated event, testing immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and event parsing.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the ThingCreated class is immutable and that its included classes are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode methods of ThingCreated using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThing
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ThingCreated instance with a null Thing throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Confirms that the toJson method produces the expected JSON output.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a ThingCreated instance from a JSON string.

methods.name: retrieveEventName
methods.description: Checks that the event name retrieval from a JSON object works as expected.

methods.name: parseThingCreatedEvent
methods.description: Verifies that a JSON object representing a ThingCreated event can be parsed back into an event object.
